name: siela-bot
description: Self-hosted single-guild Discord bot with music, economy, Tambola, TTS, and social features.

scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/bot build && bun run --cwd apps/router build && bun run --cwd apps/watchtower build && bun run --cwd apps/dashboard build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/shared typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/config typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/db typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/router typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/watchtower typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/bot typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/dashboard typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/shared test && bun run --cwd apps/bot test && bun run --cwd apps/router test && bun run --cwd apps/watchtower test && bun run --cwd apps/dashboard test
